name: LAN_FPS
notes: Next Gen online update: Map Editor (build, check, preview, play-test and host your own arenas; guests receive the map); Orbit Crown, a seeded tiny-planet arena; dynamic weather (sunny, cloudy, fog, rain); new Orbit menu theme; four new low-poly operatives (Rico, Dante, Lucia, Nina) holding their weapons in third person; appearance creator every player sees; authored stylised weapons with starburst muzzle flashes and glowing bullets that light their path; Control and Capture the Flag modes; modern combat HUD. Fixes: grenades visibly fly, guests render and load the host map, remote avatars animate, effect memory leaks.
